semiconductor_relevance: High — Micron Star Technology Limited specializes in inspection and measurement equipment critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Micron Star Technology Limited is a professional distributor of digital research instrument systems, focusing on high-quality inspection and measurement tools for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include advanced microscopy solutions and infrared cameras for defect detection in silicon wafers and electronic components.
capabilities: NIR/IR Infrared Cameras for defect detection
High-speed imaging systems for mechanical measurements

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company operates as a distributor in Taiwan, providing specialized equipment for semiconductor applications.
regional_presence.Hong Kong: Micron Star Technology Limited also serves the Hong Kong market with its range of inspection and measurement tools.
regional_presence.China: The company has a presence in China, focusing on delivering high-quality semiconductor research instruments.
